entries.what: Isabel wakes at 6:50, gets a ride from Grace at 7:30 and sits through AP Calc and AP Lang at Flats High.
entries.outcome: Got through the day on little sleep.

entries.what: After school she works at the library homework center on her summer program form and fall sports photos with Nadia.
entries.outcome: Form is nearly done, photo picks are made.

entries.what: Dishes after dinner, then she checks that Lola Cora ate her lunch leftovers while Ramón is at dispatch.
entries.outcome: Lola Cora grumbled but ate.

entries.what: Election day: Isabel is too young to vote, but walks past the community center polling line on her way to school and rolls her eyes at the Measure K signs.
entries.outcome: Skipped the debate at home.

entries.what: Robotics isn't scheduled today, so she studies for AP Chem and APUSH at the library homework center.
entries.outcome: Finished two APUSH chapters.

entries.what: At dinner the family talks about Measure K and who voted; Grace is pleased she voted, Isabel stays quiet and eats fish.
entries.outcome: Dinner ended without a fight.

entries.what: Isabel tutors Mateo in fractions and ratios at 4 p.m. for $20, using the pizza drawings again.
entries.outcome: Mateo finished all his practice problems.

entries.what: Father Ben's food drive sign-up goes out; Isabel signs herself and Lola Cora up to help on Nov 22.
entries.outcome: Committed to the Nov 22 food drive with Lola Cora.

entries.what: Late night, she tweaks the egret count notes at Ramón's old desktop before bed.
entries.outcome: Went to bed near 1 a.m.

entries.what: Thursday robotics in room C7: Lucas shares his drivetrain design review plans and Isabel quietly wants to beat them.
entries.outcome: She left with a list of weak spots in the current drivetrain.

entries.what: At home she asks the assistant for drivetrain improvements she can propose before Lucas's design review.
entries.outcome: Has three ideas to bring to the team.

entries.what: Dinner is a short, quiet one with Grace and Lola Cora; Isabel heads to her room early.
entries.outcome: No arguments tonight.

entries.what: School day with lunch in the yearbook room with Nadia, who shows her a spread layout.
entries.outcome: Chose the best football photos.

entries.what: Fernanda reads her one essay draft per week on Fridays and returns notes.
entries.outcome: Got a short list of paragraph fixes.

entries.what: Evening, Nadia drives them in her brother's sedan to see the Flats High fall play at the Ortega Playhouse.
entries.outcome: Home before the 9 p.m. curfew after a fun show.

entries.what: Saturday SAT prep time passes and she sleeps in, then goes to the library to work on the Mom sheet numbers.
entries.outcome: Collected net price figures for five schools.

entries.what: Afternoon in the driveway watching Ramón work on the Bronco carburetor while she holds the flashlight.
entries.outcome: Ramón again promised she can drive it when it runs.

entries.what: Evening at home with a jasmine milk tea from Cloud Nine, writing out her egret count gear list.
entries.outcome: Packed her bag for the count a week out.

entries.what: Sunday morning she goes with Grace and Lola Cora to Tagalog Mass at 9 a.m. at Our Lady of the Marsh.
entries.outcome: Sat through Mass without complaint.

entries.what: Lola Cora cooks sinigang for lunch and Isabel eats two bowls while pretending to be indifferent.
entries.outcome: Lola Cora saves leftovers for her.

entries.what: Grace grades at the kitchen table while Isabel does homework nearby; Hana's return to work is mentioned only in town talk.
entries.outcome: Worked side by side in near silence.
